component.name: Biyan
component.summary: Desktop AI client for cloud and OpenAI-compatible providers

description.p: Biyan is a desktop AI client for configured cloud and OpenAI-compatible providers. It requires network access and provider credentials and does not bundle or run local AI models.

ul.li: Connect to configured cloud and OpenAI-compatible providers
Create tailored assistants for writing, coding, summarizing, and more
Use Model Context Protocol integrations for tools and workflows
Keep provider choice and credentials under user control

description.p: Biyan is actively maintained by Jingxing. Feedback, bug reports, and feature requests are welcome through GitHub.
